component.name: LPT Pro
component.summary: Copy photos and videos from your iPhone to this computer

description.p: LPT Pro (Local Photo Transfer) shows everything on your iPhone and tells you exactly what is already backed up on your computer. Back up what is missing with one button.

ul.li: Every copy is verified before it counts
Sorted into folders by the date each photo was taken, original dates kept
Optionally saves HEIC photos as JPEG
Built-in photo viewer and video player
Album mode: browse your backup by year and month, no iPhone needed
Honest about photos whose original is only in iCloud
Never changes or deletes anything on the iPhone, and never uses the internet

description.p: Needs the usbmuxd service and a USB cable. No Apple account or iTunes is needed.

screenshot.caption: See what is backed up and copy what is missing

description.p: Fixes wrong video tile pictures and silent videos with several sound tracks.
Better adding from synced iCloud folders; iCloud photos recognised whatever their file name.
Favorites and Export favorites in Album mode; the grid follows the viewer.
Album mode: browse the backup on the PC without the iPhone.
Backs up library photos stored outside the camera roll; Shared with You no longer counted.
Add downloaded photos: sorts photos from a folder or zip files (e.g. from iCloud) into the backup by date.
Deleted photos never flash up; one Show choice (Everything, On this iPhone, Only in iCloud, Not backed up yet).
Shows iCloud-only photos with their previews and explains how to get the originals.
Counts photos that are only in iCloud, so nothing is reported as backed up when it isn't.
"Hide Recently Deleted" always shown; tidier folder list.
Recognises the iPhone's Recently Deleted album: hidden and skipped by default.
